_: Phobos, the new forty-nine (2026-11-19): each takes the place of a palette swap in their district (src/folk/people.js). Their lines: tools/phobos/crowd_lines_brief.md, in src/folk/lines/crowd/part7..10.js.

people.name: Master Thibault Vane
people.title: an astrologer
people.look: A stooped old astrologer of about seventy, long white beard, spectacles, a tall soft dark-violet felt cap, a long dark-violet scholar's robe scattered with small embroidered silver stars, ink-stained fingers, soft slippers.

people.name: Wenna Crale
people.title: an alchemist's assistant
people.look: A young alchemist's assistant of about twenty-four, singed short dark hair, soot and burn marks on her cheeks, round smoked-glass goggles pushed up on her forehead, a heavy scorched leather apron over a moss-green dress with rolled sleeves, thick gloves tucked in her belt.

people.name: Ansel Thorpe
people.title: a bookbinder
people.look: A neat, thin bookbinder of about fifty, receding grey hair, a sharp nose, a dark brown waistcoat over a white linen shirt with sleeve garters, a leather apron with awls and thread in its pocket, dark breeches, buckled shoes.

people.name: Sabine Hollow
people.title: an ink-maker
people.look: An ink-maker woman of about forty, black-stained hands and forearms to the elbow, dark hair pinned up in a net, a plain charcoal-grey dress with a black-stained canvas apron, a little cap, wooden clogs.

people.name: Old Nettle
people.title: a herbalist
people.look: A sly old herbalist woman of about sixty-five, wrinkled sharp face, grey hair in a loose bun stuck with twigs, a layered moss-green and brown shawl, a long faded olive skirt, many bundles of dried herbs and little bags hanging from her belt, bare feet in wooden pattens.

people.name: Magister Odo Pell
people.title: a tutor of the Rise
people.look: A pompous tutor of about sixty, clean-shaven jowly face, grey hair, a black academic gown with wide sleeves over a dark red-brown doublet, a flat square black cap, a white collar band, polished black shoes.

people.name: Hob Quarrel
people.title: a crossbowman of the wall
people.look: A crossbowman of a city wall, about thirty, lean stubbled face, a round iron kettle helmet, a blood-red padded surcoat over mail, a quiver of bolts on his hip, a crossbow slung on his back, tall brown boots.

people.name: Eustace Wim
people.title: a clerk of the gate
people.look: A pinched gate clerk of about forty-five, thinning hair combed over, small round spectacles, a black coat buttoned to the throat, ink stains on his cuffs, a wax tablet hung from his belt, grey breeches, black shoes.

people.name: Dunk Harrow
people.title: an ostler
people.look: A burly stable ostler of about thirty-five, ruddy face, straw in his messy brown hair, a sleeveless dun leather jerkin over a sweat-stained linen shirt, a horse-brush and coiled lead rope on his belt, mucky boots.

people.name: Brida Nail
people.title: a farrier
people.look: A strong woman farrier of about forty, muscular bare forearms, dark hair in a thick braid, a heavy split leather apron to her knees over a rust-brown shirt, a hammer and tongs at her belt, heavy boots.

people.name: Gil Wainwright
people.title: a carter
people.look: A weather-beaten carter of about fifty, wide-brimmed battered felt hat, grey stubble, a long dusty oilcloth coat over a brown waistcoat, a coiled whip at his belt, dusty breeches, high boots.

people.name: Sergeant Brask
people.title: a drill sergeant
people.look: A barrel-chested drill sergeant of about forty-five, shaved head, enormous moustache, a scarred face, a blood-red tabard over an iron mail shirt, thick leather belt, iron vambraces, heavy boots.

people.name: Hanne Riveter
people.title: an armourer
people.look: A broad woman armourer of about forty, soot-streaked face, short dark curly hair under a leather cap, a heavy scorched leather apron over a sleeveless grey shirt, leather arm guards, pliers and rivets at her belt, heavy boots.

people.name: Linnet Shaft
people.title: a fletcher
people.look: A young woman fletcher of about twenty-seven, freckles, red-brown hair in a braid over her shoulder, a fitted dark green jerkin over a cream shirt, a quiver of unfinished arrows on her back, a pouch of grey goose feathers, brown hose, ankle boots.

people.name: Mother Gruel
people.title: a garrison cook
people.look: A stout garrison cook of about fifty-five, red cheeks, grey hair under a white linen cap, sleeves rolled up over strong arms, a huge grease-stained apron over a brown dress, a ladle and knife at her belt, clogs.

people.name: Ser Corvin Dask
people.title: a banner-bearer of the Loyal
people.look: A tall stern banner-bearer of a dark lord's guard, about thirty-five, pale clean-shaven face, black hair, blackened iron plate armour over blood-red cloth, a long blood-red cloak, a banner pole strapped to his back with a plain red pennant, no symbols.

people.name: Brother Scour
people.title: a penitent
people.look: A gaunt penitent of about forty, shaved scabbed head, wild staring eyes, bare scarred torso and shoulders, a coarse undyed sackcloth kilt bound with rope, a knotted cord whip at his belt, bare dirty feet.

people.name: Gammer Pyx
people.title: a seller of relics
people.look: A crafty old relic-seller woman of about sixty, a crooked smile, grey hair under a dark hood, a patched maroon shawl, a tray-box hung on a strap round her neck full of little bones, teeth and tiny bottles, a long brown skirt, worn shoes.

people.name: Master Aumbry
people.title: a tithe-collector of the Keep
people.look: A cold tithe-collector of about fifty, thin pale face, slicked black hair, a long black coat with blood-red lining showing at the cuffs, a heavy iron-bound coin box on a strap at his side, black gloves, black boots.

people.name: Sister Morrow
people.title: a devotee of the Keep
people.look: A pale devotee woman of about thirty, dark eyes ringed with kohl, black hair loose to her waist, a long plain blood-red gown with a black rope belt, a black lace veil over her hair, bare feet.

people.name: Tam Puffer
people.title: a bellows-boy
people.look: A soot-covered boy of about thirteen who works a furnace's bellows, skinny, burn scars on his arms, shaggy black hair, a scorched sleeveless brown tunic, a leather apron too big for him, wrapped rag gloves, bare feet.

people.name: Ma Clinker
people.title: a furnace tender
people.look: A hardened furnace-woman of about forty-five, red sweating face, grey-streaked hair tied in a red rag, a thick scorched leather tabard over a sooty dun shirt, long leather gauntlets, heavy wooden-soled boots.

people.name: Big Ottar
people.title: a coal-heaver
people.look: A huge coal-heaver of about thirty-three, black with coal dust, bald, a thick neck, a leather shoulder-pad for carrying sacks, a sleeveless filthy grey vest, coarse black trousers tied with rope, heavy boots.

people.name: Renaud Fyre
people.title: a glassblower
people.look: A flamboyant glassblower of about forty, curly dark hair, a trimmed beard, a sweat-soaked deep green shirt open at the neck, a heat-scorched leather apron, a long blowpipe strapped across his back, brown breeches, short boots.

people.name: Granny Ash
people.title: an ash-sifter
people.look: A tiny bent old ash-sifter woman of about seventy-five, grey with ash from head to foot, a ragged grey hood and shawl, a big round sieve hung on her back, a long patched skirt, rag-wrapped feet.

people.name: Ambrose Quillfeather
people.title: a majordomo of a great house
people.look: A haughty majordomo of a rich house, about fifty-five, powdered grey hair tied back, a long plum-coloured livery coat with brass buttons, a white lace cravat, white stockings, buckled black shoes, a tall staff of office on his back.

people.name: Madame Isaure
people.title: a courtesan of Dukes' Row
people.look: An elegant courtesan of about thirty, dark red hair piled high with pearls, a low-cut emerald-green velvet gown with long trailing sleeves, a black lace shawl, long black gloves, rings.

people.name: Lord Peregrine Asche
people.title: a duelling fop
people.look: A slender swaggering duellist dandy of about twenty-five, styled chestnut hair, a pointed beard, a slashed burgundy and black doublet with puffed sleeves, a short cape on one shoulder, a rapier at his hip, fine thigh boots.

people.name: the Dowager Cressida
people.title: a dowager of Dukes' Row
people.look: A severe old dowager of about seventy-eight, a wrinkled proud face, white hair under a black lace mantilla, a heavy high-necked black silk mourning gown with a ruff, a cane, many dark rings.

people.name: Old Lamech
people.title: a sexton
people.look: A bent old sexton of about seventy, long thin grey hair, sunken cheeks, a long rusty-black coat, a ring of large iron keys at his belt, a dark scarf, worn black boots.

people.name: Ottilie Shroud
people.title: an embalmer
people.look: A calm embalmer woman of about forty-five, pale skin, dark hair bound tight under a white coif, a long dark grey dress, a stained white linen apron, long linen sleeve covers, small bottles and a pouch of linen strips at her belt.

people.name: Hild the Washer
people.title: a washer of the dead
people.look: A grim corpse-washer woman of about fifty, raw red hands, a stained grey headscarf, a dun dress with sleeves pinned up, a wet sacking apron, a bucket hung from her belt, wooden clogs.

people.name: Corwin Lamp
people.title: a lantern-man of the dead-watch
people.look: A hollow-eyed dead-watch man of about forty, hooded charcoal-grey cloak, a long iron-shod stave on his back, a hooded lantern hung at his belt, a padded grey coat, sturdy boots.

people.name: Peg Slither
people.title: an eel-seller
people.look: A loud eel-seller woman of about forty-five, weathered face, frizzy grey-brown hair under a stained kerchief, a wet oilskin apron over a faded mustard dress, rolled sleeves, a wicker basket on her back, wooden clogs.

people.name: Ulf Keelson
people.title: a shipwright
people.look: A broad shipwright of about fifty, braided grey-blond beard, a weather-lined face, a knitted brown cap, a canvas smock with rolled sleeves, a leather tool belt with an adze and mallet, tarred breeches, sea boots.

people.name: Nan Brackwater
people.title: a smuggler
people.look: A sly woman smuggler of about thirty-five, weathered tan face, dark hair under a black knitted cap, a long dark-brown oilskin coat with many hidden pockets, a striped dun and red shirt, a knife at her belt, sea boots.

people.name: Jack Brine
people.title: a sailor
people.look: A tattooed sailor of about twenty-eight, sun-darkened skin, an earring, a red scarf tied round his head, a loose striped cream-and-brown shirt, a short tarred jacket, wide canvas trousers rolled at the calves, bare feet.

people.name: Silas Mote
people.title: a pawnbroker
people.look: A miserly pawnbroker of about sixty, hunched, wispy grey hair, half-moon spectacles, a shabby moth-eaten mustard waistcoat over a stained shirt, fingerless gloves, a ring of small keys at his belt, worn slippers.

people.name: Bessie Tallow
people.title: the cook of the Gutted Lamb
people.look: A big tavern cook of about fifty, red face, fat forearms, greasy grey-blond hair escaping a stained cap, a grimy apron over a rust-brown dress, a dish-rag over her shoulder, clogs.

people.name: Lucky Ferris
people.title: a card-sharp
people.look: A smooth card-sharp of about thirty, slick black hair, a thin smile, a faded brocade waistcoat in dull gold-brown over a loose black shirt, a red silk neckerchief, black breeches, cracked fine boots.

people.name: Widow Crake
people.title: a lodging-house keeper
people.look: A hard-eyed lodging-house widow of about fifty-five, iron-grey hair scraped into a bun, a black dress gone brown with age, a grey shawl, a heavy ring of keys at her waist, a wooden cudgel at her belt, worn boots.

people.name: Matilde Curd
people.title: a cheesemonger
people.look: A round cheerful cheesemonger of about forty, rosy cheeks, light brown hair under a white kerchief, a cream-coloured blouse, a dark brown bodice, a long straw-yellow skirt, a white apron, a small cheese knife at her belt, clogs.

people.name: Ned Sole
people.title: a cobbler
people.look: A small cobbler of about fifty-five, bald with grey side hair, a bulbous nose, a leather apron over a dull red shirt with rolled sleeves, a pair of boots hung by the laces over his shoulder, awls at his belt, patched shoes.

people.name: Hamund Crock
people.title: a potter
people.look: A clay-spattered potter of about thirty-five, curly sandy hair, a short beard, a clay-smeared grey smock, forearms grey with dried clay, a dun apron, rough brown trousers, bare feet in sandals.

people.name: Goody Rue
people.title: a herb-seller
people.look: A small herb-seller woman of about sixty, kind lined face, white hair in a plait, a faded lavender-grey dress, a green apron with deep pockets stuffed with sprigs, a flat basket of herbs on her hip strap, wooden pattens.

people.name: Abner Hyde
people.title: a currier
people.look: A currier of about forty-five who dresses leather, muscular stained arms, cropped brown hair, a sweat-stained sleeveless tan shirt, a thick dark leather apron, wooden scraping tools at his belt, high leather boots.

people.name: Rook Flaye
people.title: a skinner
people.look: A grim skinner of about forty, a blood-stained leather apron over a grubby grey shirt, a hooked knife at his belt, lank black hair, a tattooed forearm, a rolled bundle of raw hides tied on his back, stained boots.

people.name: Clemence Fyne
people.title: a glover
people.look: A neat woman glover of about thirty-five, dark hair in a tidy plait, a fitted dark brown bodice over a cream blouse, a small leather apron, several pairs of fine gloves hung from her belt, a deep red skirt, soft shoes.

people.name: Gert Lather
people.title: a soap-boiler
people.look: A big soap-boiler woman of about fifty, red raw hands, a sweaty face, grey hair under a stained linen cap, a long lye-bleached apron over a faded olive dress, a wooden paddle strapped on her back, clogs.
